label: Newsom will not be president
description: A direct declaration addressed to the California governor that he will not be president of the United States, given because of scandals attached to him. Distinct from newsom-removed-early, which is about his term ending, and from newsom-ambitions.
aliases: you will not be the president of the United States of America
You will not

There's stuff on Camila
files files files

label: Iran receives 400 rocket launchers from China through Pakistan

he told me very strongly he wouldn't partake
